en: A color-tinted illustration of a railway station at sunset or sunrise. Several parallel train tracks run toward the horizon, with freight wagons on the left and a long, two‑story station building with a red roof and covered platform on the right. A few figures stand on the platform and near the tracks. Bare trees are visible in the background, suggesting autumn or winter. The title text is printed in red at the top left.
